paths.title: Six learning paths
paths.lede: Choose by goal, not by course number. Each path gives a core sequence and optional courses.

semester.title: Courses by term
semester.lede: The 55 core courses split across the 2026–27 terms. A course may be offered in multiple terms; term data comes from ExploreCourses, so verify before enrolling.
semester.notOfferedNote: These courses are not in the current year's catalogue; the pages keep the official record so they are easy to find when they return.

bilibili.title: Bilibili course resources
bilibili.lede: A collection of third-party Stanford AI/ML course mirrors and Chinese-dubbed versions on Bilibili. They may break, miss episodes, or lag the current version; prefer the official course site and Stanford Online YouTube recordings.
